questions.prompt: In Billings, a drink counts as an alcoholic beverage if it has more than how much alcohol?
choices: More than 0.5 percent alcohol by volume
More than 5 percent alcohol by volume
Only hard liquor sold in bars
Any drink that has even a trace of alcohol
questions.answer: More than 0.5 percent alcohol by volume

               et seq.

The following words and phrases, when used in this article, shall have the meanings
               respectively ascribed to them: Alcohol means ethyl alcohol, also called ethanol, or the hydrated oxide of ethyl. Alcoholic beverage means a compound produced and sold for human consumption as a drink that contains
               more than five-tenths (.5) percent of alcohol by volume. Motor vehicles means every vehicle which is self-propelled by which any person or property is or
               may be, transported or drawn upon a public highway. Public display or exhibitionism of alcoholic beverages means and includes the carrying and exhibiting of open cans, bottles, glasses or
               other types of containers of alcoholic beverages, either empty or containing alcoholic
               beverages, from retail alcoholic beverage establishments to, in, on, or within any
               motor vehicles or upon any public place within the city; but does not include carrying
               or transporting such alcoholic beverage from retail establishments in sacks, cases,
               boxes, cartons or other similar containers with unbroken seals or containers when
               no display or exhibition is made. Public drinking means and includes the drinking or consuming of alcoholic beverages in, on, within
               or upon any motor vehicle or any public places in the city. Public place means a place, building, or conveyance to which the public has or may be permitted
               to have access and any place of public resort and includes all motor vehicles found
